Finished by [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] sculptors in [[4985 BBY]], this four-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall glass '''statue''' of [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] leader [[Yaru Korsin]] was presented to him in the [[Kesh Sith Temple]]. Although it drew a rave review from Korsin's wife [[Seelah Korsin|Seelah's]] Keshiri aide [[Tilden Kaah]], neither Korsin thought it looked much like him.<ref name="paragon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''</ref>
